summary: Load lossless MXFP4-CSF checkpoints of DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
compatibility: Opt-in: serve a deepseek_v4_flash MXFP4-CSF serving directory with --quantization mxfp4_csf --load-format mxfp4_csf. Original checkpoints and their launch flags are unchanged.
details: The deepseek_v4_flash family reads the compressed scales of 256 routed MXFP4 experts in each of the 43 target layers by DeepSeek's native tensor names, at TP1, TP2, TP4 or TP8.
Routed experts use MXFP8 activations like the native B12X MXFP4 path unless VLLM_B12X_MOE_FP4_FORCE_A16=1 requests BF16.
Attention, dense and shared-expert weights keep the source block-FP8 configuration. MTP/DSpark draft experts, the vision tower, the aligner and the image embeddings load unchanged.
Expert-parallel execution, including MegaMoE, is rejected because those experts would bypass the compressed-scale reader.
